`git rebase --onto` lets you choose a new base for a range of commits. It takes some of a branch's commits and replays them somewhere else.

## Syntax

```
git rebase --onto <newbase> <upstream> [<branch>]
```

Git takes the commits that are in `<branch>` but not in `<upstream>`, i.e. the range `upstream..branch`, and replays them on top of `<newbase>`. `<branch>` defaults to the current branch.

A plain `git rebase main` uses one ref for two jobs: it decides which commits to move and where to put them. `--onto` lets you set those two things separately.

## Example: moving a branch off another feature branch

You started `feature-b` from `feature-a`, but `feature-b` doesn't need anything from `feature-a`:

```
main:       A---B---C
                     \
feature-a:            D---E
                           \
feature-b:                  F---G
```

You want only `F` and `G`, placed directly on `main`:

```
git rebase --onto main feature-a feature-b
```

This means: take the commits in `feature-b` that aren't in `feature-a` (`F` and `G`) and replay them onto `main`. The result:

```
main:       A---B---C
                    |\
feature-a:          | D---E
                     \
feature-b:            F'---G'
```

A plain `git rebase main` on `feature-b` would have brought `D` and `E` along too.

## Other uses

- **Drop commits from the middle of a branch.** `git rebase --onto HEAD~5 HEAD~3` removes the two commits `HEAD~4` and `HEAD~3` (the range is exclusive of `HEAD~5`) and keeps the commits after them.
- **After the parent branch was squash-merged.** If `feature-a` was squash-merged into `main`, run `git rebase --onto main <old-feature-a-tip> feature-b` so you don't replay commits that are already in `main`.

## Notes

- Like any rebase, this rewrites history. The new commits (`F'`, `G'`) get new hashes, so if you've already pushed the branch you'll need `git push --force-with-lease`.
- If something goes wrong, `git rebase --abort` stops a rebase that's still in progress. After it finishes, `git reflog` shows the old branch tip so you can reset back to it.
